market_question: Will Warren Buffett be richest person on December 31?
reasoning: Warren Buffett is currently around the 7th richest person with a net worth of ~$140B, far behind Elon Musk (~$400B+), Bezos, Arnault, etc. He is 95 years old and has pledged to give away 99% of his wealth, making his net worth likely to decline rather than surge to #1. The probability of him overtaking all others by Dec 31, 2026, is vanishingly small, well below 0.02%.
evidence_points: Buffett is ~$260B+ behind the top spot and his wealth is heavily in Berkshire Hathaway, which grows slower than tech-driven fortunes.
He has been consistently donating billions to charity, reducing his net worth over time.
The Bloomberg Billionaires Index rarely shows anyone but Musk, Bezos, or Arnault at #1; drastic shifts would require an unimaginable collapse of all leaders simultaneously.
sources_consulted: Public records of Buffett's charitable pledges and net worth trends
